title: Mystic Apothecary Sorceress
description: A woman wearing an emerald green hooded robe and white floral headpiece stands behind a marble apothecary counter, her right hand touching a glowing purple crystal ball. The shop is filled with potion bottles, labeled jars, scrolls, herbs, and magical floating sigils and sparkles.
prompt: A beautiful young woman in an emerald green hooded robe with white floral decorations stands in a magical apothecary shop, reaching toward a glowing purple crystal ball on the counter. The scene is filled with potion bottles, labeled jars of herbs, floating scrolls, magical sigils, and sparkling purple smoke and light particles. Warm mystical lighting, intricate details, fantasy illustration style.
